[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure=”1_2,1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text disabled_on=”on|on|off” _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” link_font=”|||on|||||” link_text_color=”#BB1C29″ header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”5vw” text_orientation=”center” max_width=”850px” module_alignment=”center” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”9vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

When building a new home or replacing the roof on your existing home, there are many various types of roofing to select from. Shingle Roofing is one of the most common.

There are several advantages to having a shingle roof installed on your home in Louisiana. The first advantage to mention is the fact that Shingles are a popular roofing option because they are inexpensive. They also come in a variety of styles and price points, allowing you to pick the one that best fits your budget and style choices.

Another important advantage of Shingle Roofing is that it is incredibly simple to install, allowing us to complete your roof efficiently and without many issues. Shingles are adaptable to a variety of architectural designs and may be fitted on even the steepest roofs. They are also simple for us to cut and custom-fit them, lowering your installation expenses.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type=”1_2″ _builder_version=”4.16″ _module_preset=”default” global_colors_info=”{}”][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.16″ text_font=”Heebo||||||||” text_text_color=”#000000″ text_font_size=”17px” text_line_height=”1.9em” link_font=”|||on|||||” link_text_color=”#BB1C29″ header_font=”Poppins|700||on|||||” header_text_align=”center” header_text_color=”#1E73B9″ header_font_size=”5vw” text_orientation=”center” max_width=”850px” module_alignment=”center” text_font_size_tablet=”18px” text_font_size_phone=”15px” text_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” header_font_size_tablet=”5vw” header_font_size_phone=”9vw” header_font_size_last_edited=”on|phone” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Shingles come in a broad range of sizes, colors, and materials, allowing you to select the one that best suits your unique design ideas and preferences. Asphalt shingles are the most cost-effective, but if you don’t like the way they appear, there are numerous other options. Shingle roofing also requires no additional equipment to install, are extremely simple to maintain and really safe. They are light, most are fireproof, and you can walk on them without causing damage. If you’re not sure which roofing material to use, shingles are a safe bet.

In Central Louisiana, Farris Roofing provides Shingle Roofing installation and maintenance. Whether you are building a new roof or replacing an existing one, because your roof is such a large investment, it’s critical that you select the appropriate material for your home, budget and future and we can help you with those decisions.
